scripts.compact: rm -rf src/managed && compact compile src/jubjub-schnorr.compact src/managed/jubjub-schnorr && node ./scripts/align-runtime-version.mjs && node ./scripts/strip-managed-sourcemaps.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm run compact && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.test:ci: pnpm run compact && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts
scripts.coverage: pnpm run compact && vitest run --config vitest.config.ts --coverage
scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && rm -rf coverage && rm -rf reports && rm -rf src/managed
scripts.build: pnpm run compact && rm -rf dist && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --force && mkdir -p dist && cp -Rf ./src/managed ./dist/ && cp ./src/jubjub-schnorr.compact ./src/schnorr.compact ./dist
scripts.all: pnpm run compact && pnpm run build && pnpm run test:ci
